descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S10 「现成的 spec：读照片接到 Vertex Gemini，prompt 原样发出去」 Existing specs: photo reading is wired to Vertex Gemini and the prompt goes in unchanged

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T4 A photographed prior note is read by Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI. The prototype's photo-reading instruction text is used word for word with only the request format adapted, and the read text ke …（TFA-94425 AC 1；TFA-94425 AC 2；TFA-94425 AC 3；TFA-94425 AC 4）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Provider configuration (api project, no network)

When Read the default vision provider and model, route a photo, build the Vertex request

Then The default vision provider is Vertex with a Gemini Flash model. A photo goes to the configured model with the prompt text unchanged, in the native Vertex request shape

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in api/providers.spec.ts. This covers defaults and wiring only. DEFAULT_VISION_MODEL is gemini-3.6-flash, the model that returned 404 on dev before PR #102. Which model really answered is S21; word-for-word parity is S25

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S10 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-13.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
